lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill region, transitioning into a more distributed grid pattern across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a discernible checkerboard grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Elongated high-luminance object (commensal organism) visible trailing the ventral surface near the pectoral fin base.
